notes.title: About Pa!nt Service Transfer
notes.notes: [p]Hello, I'm BIBGames, who has been developing Pa!nt.[/p][p]Sorry for not having any separate announcements and updates for a long period of time last year's update of Early Access.[/p][p]Currently, BIBGames has been working on a full version since the development of Steam's early access version.[/p][p]Unfortunately, however, due to internal management issues, the company is cleaning up its employees. Currently, the company is in the process of cleaning up.[/p][p]In the process, Pa!nt was decided to transfer the service from BIBGames to YellowPop, and Pa!nt, which has been developed so far, was delivered to YellowPop in August 2025.[/p][p]Although the developer has changed, I would like to thank you for your love of Pa!nt, and I would also like to ask for your love and interest in Pa!nt, which will be developed and officially released again by YellowPop.[/p][p]Thank you so much for loving BIBGames.[/p]

notes.title: 24.10.15 Bug Hot Fix
notes.notes:
Hello, this is BIBGames.

We have identified and fixed several bugs in the previous version.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused during gameplay.

We will continue to do our best to quickly identify issues and respond promptly based on player feedback.

Thank you.


[h3]1. Reassessment of Time-Related Achievements[/h3]

The unit for the criteria of time-related achievements has changed from seconds to minutes. As a result, if an achievement was previously considered completed despite not meeting the new conditions, it will be reverted to an incomplete status, and the associated rewards will also be revoked.


[h3]2. Issue with Exiting After Playing in the Level Editor[/h3]

We have resolved the issue where players could not return to the list after clearing another player's map in the level editor, even when pressing the left list button or the right like button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/d230e5a6dc59fc35abf9e4bbef6cf12ce7b5839a.png[/img]

notes.title: 24.10.11 Bug Hot Fix
notes.notes:
Hello, this is BIBGames.

In the previous version, several bugs and improvements were found and fixed.

We apologize for the inconvenience in playing the game.

We will continue to do our best to quickly find problems and take action based on player feedback.

Thank you.


[h2]Bugs[/h2]

[h3]1. Issue with duplicate pointers in the settings window[/h3]

We have fixed the issue where duplicate pointers were being displayed for the currently selected button in the settings panel.

[h3]2. Missing translation for control guide text[/h3]

We added the missing translation for the control guide in the setting panel that explains, "Regardless of the mode, you can play it freely with the key you want."

[h3]3. Time-related achievements not unlocking[/h3]

We have fixed the issue where time-related achievements were not being unlocked in the in-game banner, in-game achievement panel, or Steam achievements.

After the build update, if the achievement requirements are met, the achievements will be unlocked.


[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]1. Background execution enabled[/h3]

The game will now continue running in the background, even when the game window loses focus.

[h3]2. Improved user experience in the settings window[/h3]

We have improved the category selection process in the settings panel.

Previously, when using the keyboard, you had to press Z or Enter again to switch the panel, but now the panel changes immediately once the category is selected.

[h3]3. Improved user experience for mouse drawing function[/h3]

The recognition rate for drawing/erasing with the mouse has been improved.

[h3]4. Updated design of the text input field[/h3]

The design of the text input field has been updated to better match the overall game atmosphere.

notes.title: [D-1]Pa!nt for anyone to enjoy will be released tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]The next 1 day until Pa!nt's early access launch![/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/c2906d2b7c06e476175c5d17a31fcfc4280e9811.png[/img]
The new feature of Pa!nt that I'm going to introduce today is

[b][h2]Black and white mode for colorblind users.[/h2][/b]

Previously, Pa!nt provided a[b][h2] color filter function[/h2][/b] to allow all users to enjoy Pa!nt.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/dc0b697e52afb8032ba93cff638d4282e930f3ac.png[/img]
The existing color filter function was to make the same color a little transparent.
However, I felt that these functions were difficult to provide clearer help to actual users.

In this regard, we have prepared [b][h2]a new black-and-white version[/h2][/b] of the experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/da5104c6e7b1f5e401bb4af3d9759bd6794534bd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/6e47d535eea3788685069d8cac2d5da0e5cfc619.png[/img]

We hope that this will enable a new play to enjoy Pa!nt once again.

Also, the black and white mode design is still under revision, so it will be a fun point to enjoy Pa!nt's progressive and new appearance in the future, so please look forward to it!


Then, let's meet through a game!

notes.title: [D-2]Pa!nt full of colorful puzzles is coming soon!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]There are 2 days left until the release of Pa!nt![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/435865dfe7db4900e3816fa0fe8d4dfe69dfd5c7.png[/img]
[h2][b]What's the new update for Pa!nt that We're going to tell you today? [/b][/h2]



[h2][b]It's a hint! [/b][/h2]
In fact, one of the difficulties that many users experienced while developing the game was that when one stage was blocked because it was too difficult, there was no way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/4cddabba2094bb6a000566bb7e2fb11b2a7cc28e.png[/img]
In fact, We've tried various things to solve this problem.
Then, we finally added a hint to the content.

[b][h3]Hints that make the game too easy? [/h3] [/b]
A lot of players were worried about seeing the hints, that the game would be less fun because they gave the correct answer, or that it wouldn't help because of too complicated hints.

[h3] [b]A refreshing hint that only loosens up the blocked parts! [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/e155a3fc16a1e4e5562b3b7699c6984a68009cee.png[/img]
The new addition to Pa!nt is when you use it at that moment when you're stuck playing,
[b]It's only possible to get a hint until the moment it's blocked.
[/b]This hint tells you the sequence between points where you are arrowing from the point where you have acquired or used the item to the next use or acquisition point.
At this time, through the color of the arrow, you can know the color of Mooney at that moment, so you can get the exact information of the desired moment.[/b][/h3][/b]

This hint function is only available in [b] beginner mode for those who want to enjoy Pa!nt but are worried about it being difficult [/b], so if you were enjoying the challenge of the puzzle, it will be playable as before, so don't worry!

For players who only want to get hints about the direction of play itself, check out the name of the stage!
Sometimes, [b] We also put keywords [/b] that can be a hint of play through the name of the stage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/ad67b01fb504ff3a7f0f3daeb31e70f033bb2614.png[/img]

notes.title: Pa!nt(Colorful Puzzle Platformer): Developer Play and QnA
notes.notes:
[h1]Live Developer Gameplay Showcase![/h1]

Join us for a live gameplay session of Pa!nt, a puzzle game with doodle-style graphics inside a notebook. The developer will play the game, and you can participate in a Q&A session. Feel free to give feedback, solve puzzles together, or ask any questions you have about the game!
(Note: Please note that the developer leading the broadcast is not a puzzle designer and may find it challenging to solve puzzles smoothly. Your understanding during potential moments of frustration is appreciated.)

[h2][Game Introduction][/h2]
Pa!nt is a 2D color puzzle-platformer set in a notebook world, filled with puzzles of various colors. Can you navigate through and solve the challenging puzzles in this hand-drawn, adorable Pa!nt world?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/4d417bb536cc90f567c072204c0280ebe22cdc85.png[/img]

[h2][Meet Moonie!][/h2]
Moonie is a little octopus friend born from doodles! In the notebook world, Moonie can pass through the same color but not through different colors. Utilize this special ability to solve a variety of puzzles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/31f0915e2479cf64c1f6aaa8e49f45d5d20fef6c.gif[/img]
Try solving the puzzle by changing colors!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398504/5e50038b81da404ff0a5326567e1746fcf495ce3.gif[/img]
